_comment: Alpha was retired on 2026-09-28 (owner's instruction) and, the same day, erased from the site (owner: 「Alphaは公式に配信を終了したことを記載し、抹消」). `retired_version` is the last pack release: 13 placeholder jars that switch Alpha off, kept because Corvus delivers it. `last_playable` is the last version that carried Alpha's content; its zip is no longer on the site. While `retired` is true, Alpha is not a source of the recipe sheet (extract_recipes.py, check_recipe_sources.py) and the download and Alpha pages are the retirement notice.
